text: Carpentry is a craft that involves creating structures and objects using wood and other materials. It encompasses a wide range of skills, from assembling furniture to building houses. A fundamental aspect of carpentry is the use of joints, which provide the structural integrity of a piece. There are many types of joints, including the mortise and tenon, dovetail, and scarf joints, each requiring different techniques and tools. By carefully constructing joints, carpenters ensure the stability and durability of their creations. Once the joints are complete, the object can be finished with varnish, a protective coating that enhances its appearance and prevents decay or damage.
